prompt: a quiet lakeside town of glassblowers and lantern makers, warm light at night, no walls

card.name: Lantern Shore

site.text: a quiet town on the shore of a lake, open to the water, no walls

style.text: warm, cozy, glowing lantern light at night, glass and timber, soft amber palette

purpose.text: a craft town of glassblowers and lantern makers

program.notes: Furnace hall with glass-roofed kiln, chimneys, display of colored glass; lit warmly at night.
Small kiln, glass panes in windows, shelves of bottles.
Hanging lanterns under eaves, workbenches, stacks of finished lanterns.
Homes for craftspeople, each with a lantern at the door and glass windows.
Sells glass and lanterns, open front facing the water.
Cozy, warm-lit, with a terrace over the lake.
Pier with moored boats and hanging lanterns.

card.interpretation: A small, peaceful town on a lake shore with open edges and no walls. Its look is warm and glowing, built around glass and lantern light. Its purpose is crafting glass and lanterns, so the buildings are workshops, homes, a market, an inn and a dock.
assumptions: Size S-M, about 12 buildings, low density for a quiet feel.
Terrain: use an existing lakeshore rather than sculpting.
Location: searched for a suitable lake, not tied to spawn.
Style uses a custom warm glass-and-timber look, not a template.
No backstory was given, so none was added.
